title: Portrait photograph of Richard S. Leghorn, Chapter 1 p. 5 (CIA U-2 history)
description: Black-and-white head-and-shoulders portrait of a man in a suit and tie, captioned "Richard S. Leghorn." The photo sits in the right margin beside text on Leghorn's view that altitude was key to overhead reconnaissance and his interest in modifying the English Electric Canberra. Page is marked Secret NOFORN, Chapter 1, page 5.
